description: Rung-4 dimensional analysis, MULTIPLICATION arm: word problems whose answer is a COMPOSITE-unit quantity formed by multiplying two quantities (work = force × distance → N·m, energy = power × time → W·s, impulse = force × time → N·s, charge = current × time → A·s, pressure × volume → Pa·L, voltage × current → V·A). Complements rung4_dimensional (the division arm: km/h, mol/l, …) and reuses the same `compute_dimensioned` harness. The gold ADJ program `observe`s two typed quantities and binds `let answer = a * b`; the ENGINE forms the composite unit tag `a·b` via Dimension::combine (combine_mul), never the model. Options are `{value, unit}` and the harness matches BOTH magnitude AND unit — so every item carries a wrong-unit distractor, including the REVERSED-order composite (`m·n` when the engine produces `n·m`, which a model that doesn't track operand order would accept) and a single-factor unit (`n`). All quantities are integers and every number in a program appears in its stem (no-result-literals gate); unit atoms are digit-free so they never pollute that gate.

items.stem: A force of 10 newtons acts over a distance of 3 meters in the direction of motion. What is the work done?
items.program:
observe force(quantity(10, n))
observe distance(quantity(3, m))
let answer = force * distance
? answer
